mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, created_by, expires_at, used_count, created_at FROM invite WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, workspace_id, created_by, expires_at, used_count, created_at FROM invite WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT i.id, i.workspace_id, i.created_by, i.expires_at, i.used_count, i.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invite_project_grant g WHERE g.invite_id = i.id AND g.access = 'write') AS write_grant_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invite_project_grant g WHERE g.invite_id = i.id AND g.access = 'read') AS read_grant_count FROM invite i WHERE i.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY i.created_at DESC, i.id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM invite WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invite (id, workspace_id, created_by, expires_at, used_count) VALUES (#{id}, #{workspaceId}, #{createdBy}, #{expiresAt}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE invite SET used_count = used_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
